bricks.description: LOOK: a dark heavyweight waterproof gabardine trench coat with the collar turned up against the wind, a damp matte wool scarf tucked under the lapels, rain-darkened fabric on the shoulders showing the twill texture; restrained moody styling, no bright logos or neon zippers.
bricks.when: A detective, a stranger, a rainy goodbye.

bricks.description: LOOK: an oversized tailored suit in a muted neutral wool, wide soft shoulders and fluid trousers, a plain T-shirt underneath, minimal accessories; relaxed confident styling, no shiny fabrics.
LOOK: a stage jacket covered in small sequins catching the light in sparks, dark trousers, a slightly theatrical silhouette; glamorous but worn, no costume-party cheapness.
bricks.when: A performer, a star, a last show.

bricks.description: LOOK: a worn black leather biker jacket with creased elbows and scuffed edges, a faded band T-shirt underneath, silver zips dulled with age; rough honest styling, no new shiny leather.
